# Phase 2.1 — Caller/callee analysis

**Source:** `02_TYPED_GRAPH_EDGES.csv.gz` (85,724 edges / 138,025 call sites), generated by
`tools/build_call_graph.py --scope app`.
**Scope:** every edge where the caller *or* the callee is app-related — `com.getmimo.*` **or** one of the 1,148
renamed app classes identified in Phase 1.

## 1. Totals

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| edges | **85,724** |
| call sites | **138,025** |
| distinct calling classes | 20,116 |
| distinct callee classes | 12,905 |
| app→app edges (both sides app-related) | 56,012 |
| edges into `platform` callees | 24,186 |
| `dynamic` (unresolved) edges | **1** |

The single unresolved target is `ra0.f0 → org.xml.sax.SAXException.<init>`: a platform class my namespace list
missed. There is **no** app class that is called but absent from the dex. That is a useful negative result: the
"missing outer classes" of Phase 1 are not reached by any static call site — they are reached through interfaces,
which is exactly why they survive renaming.

## 2. Kind distribution

| Kind | Edges |
|---|---|
| `platform` | 24,186 |
| `static` | 22,373 |
| `virtual` | 20,800 |
| `direct` | 15,319 |
| `interface` | 2,243 |
| `super` | 475 |
| `callback` | 327 |
| `dynamic` | 1 |

`callback` is the smallest and most interesting bucket: 327 registrations in the whole app-related graph. They are
enumerated in `06_CALLBACK_AND_FRAMEWORK_ENTRYPOINTS.md`.

## 3. Hubs (per class, merged classes excluded from ranking)

| Class | Out-edges | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `com.getmimo.ui.path.map.k` | 851 | largest single caller in the app namespace |
| `a70.h0` | 612 | renamed app class; short name, references app types |
| `com.getmimo.ui.common.viewpager2.TwoWayNestedScrollView` | 543 | UI plumbing |
| `ia0.d` | 521 | renamed |
| `he0.c` | 481 | renamed |
| `q70.a` | 470 | renamed |

Fan-in is dominated by `java.lang.Object` (5,937) and `g1.d0` (5,328) — the latter is a renamed class with an
exceptionally wide callee set; it is recorded here, not interpreted.

## 4. The token provider's real fan-in (per method)

Restricting to `ku.a.d(Z)Ljava/lang/String;`, i.e. *not* the merged class as a whole:

| Caller | Invoke kind | Confidence |
|---|---|---|
| `com.getmimo.data.source.remote.account.a.c()` | virtual | MEDIUM |
| `com.getmimo.data.source.remote.account.AccountRepository$deleteAccount$2` | virtual | MEDIUM |
| `com.getmimo.data.source.remote.authentication.Authentication…` (6 call sites) | virtual | MEDIUM |
| `com.getmimo.data.source.remote.authentication.a` | virtual | MEDIUM |
| `com.getmimo.data.source.remote.certificates.RemoteCertificateRepository$downloadCertificate$2` | virtual | MEDIUM |
| `com.getmimo.data.source.remote.pusher.PusherConnectionManager$initializePusher$1` | virtual | MEDIUM |
| `com.getmimo.data.source.local.aitutor.AiTutorRepository$sendMessage$2` | virtual | MEDIUM |
| `pg.a` (the execution-socket client, per mission-06) | virtual | MEDIUM |
| `fh.a` (OkHttp DI arm, per mission-06) | virtual | MEDIUM |

Nine app-side entry points, all `virtual` because the call goes through the `ku.a` field type. No `callback` and no
reflection edge touches the token path.

## 5. Non-edges worth recording

| Expected by intuition | Observed |
|---|---|
| `AccountRepository` → anything | impossible: the class is not a `class_def`; its lambdas (`$deleteAccount$2`, `$changeEmail$2`) **are** callers |
| `AuthenticationFragment` → providers | impossible: fragment not a `class_def`; only `AuthenticationFragment$configureButtons$2/3/4` exist |
| `RiveAnimationKt` → Rive runtime | impossible: only its `$RiveAnimation$6$1` and `$bytes$1` lambdas exist |
| reflection-based DI | not observed in the app namespace (20,599 reflection sites are library-internal) |

This is the positive statement of the Phase-1 caveat: the *behaviour* is present, the *class* is not, so the graph
must be read from the lambdas inward.

## 6. Per-edge fields

`caller_class, caller_method, callee_class, callee_method, kind, confidence, call_sites,
caller_is_app_named, caller_is_renamed_app, callee_present_in_dex, callee_method_matched, evidence`

`evidence` is a fixed template naming the caller method, because the evidence *is* the invoke site; the dump for
any caller is reproducible with `tools/dex_inspect.py --class <caller>`.

## 7. Limits

Static invoke sites only. Not represented: framework dispatch (see `06_…`), DI graph construction (mission-06
`DI_GRAPH.json` covers the 127 arms), callback invocations after registration, coroutine resumptions that are
dispatched through `Continuation` objects, and anything reached through WebView JavaScript.

## 8. Reproduction

```bash
cd mimo-re/mission-08 && gunzip -k 02_METHOD_RELATIONSHIPS/02_TYPED_GRAPH_EDGES.csv.gz
/tmp/venv/bin/python tools/build_call_graph.py --dex-dir /tmp/x --out 02_METHOD_RELATIONSHIPS --scope app
```
